title: family emergency, gift cards
text: Mum, it's me, I'm in trouble and I need help right now. I need you to buy gift cards and read me the numbers. Please don't tell dad, I'm so embarrassed.

title: arrested, needs bail money
text: Grandma, I've been arrested and I'm in jail. I need bail money today or I'll stay here. A lawyer will call you, please don't tell anyone.

title: hospital accident, urgent payment
text: This is the hospital. Your son was in a car accident and needs surgery. We need a payment by card before we can start the operation, please give me the card number now.

title: bank fraud department, safe account
text: This is the fraud department at your bank. Someone is trying to empty your account. To protect your savings you must move your money to a safe account today, I will give you the details.

title: tax office threat
text: This is the tax office. You owe back taxes and a warrant will be issued for your arrest today. You must pay immediately with gift cards or a wire transfer to settle the debt.

title: tech support, remote access
text: I'm calling from computer support. Your computer has a virus and hackers are stealing your data. Please install this program so I can connect to your computer and fix it, and have your bank login ready.

title: delivery customs fee
text: We have a parcel for you that is held at customs. There is an unpaid fee of a few dollars to release it. I need your credit card number to pay the customs fee today or the package will be returned.

title: kidnapping threat
text: We have your daughter. If you want to see her again, do exactly what we say. Don't hang up and don't call the police. Send the money now by wire or cash.

title: friend in need abroad
text: It's me, I'm stuck abroad. My wallet was stolen and I can't get home. Please send me money by transfer, I will pay you back as soon as I'm back, I promise.

title: boss asks for urgent wire
text: It's your boss. I'm in a meeting and can't talk. I need you to make an urgent wire transfer to a new supplier right now. Keep this confidential and send me the confirmation.

title: utility shut-off threat
text: This is the electric company. Your account is overdue and your power will be shut off within one hour. Pay now over the phone with a prepaid card to avoid disconnection.

title: prize or lottery fee
text: Congratulations, you have won a lottery prize of one million dollars. To release your winnings you first need to pay a small processing fee. Please buy a voucher and read me the code.

title: real delivery
text: Hi, this is the delivery driver. I have a parcel for you and I'm outside your building. Could you tell me which door or buzzer to use? I can leave it with a neighbour.

title: doctor's office callback
text: Hello, this is the doctor's office calling back about your appointment. We would like to confirm your visit for next Tuesday afternoon. Please call us if the time does not suit you.
